content.value_statement: Regex search misses semantic code shapes and creates noisy results. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to use ast-grep patterns for precise code search and refactoring.
actual_capabilities: Search for function calls, imports, hooks, classes, and control-flow structures by AST shape.
Provide ast-grep commands for JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust patterns.
Preview and apply targeted refactors with ast-grep replacement patterns.
Create reusable YAML rules and run ast-grep scans for repeatable checks.
Use security pattern references to locate risky APIs and hardcoded credential patterns.
limitations: Requires the ast-grep CLI to be installed in the local environment.
Pattern accuracy depends on the selected language and valid ast-grep syntax.
Replacement commands can modify files and should be reviewed before use.
Security matches still require human review to confirm real vulnerabilities.

use_cases.title: Find API Usage Across a Codebase
use_cases.description: Locate calls, imports, and async patterns without relying on fragile text matches.

use_cases.title: Prepare Large Refactors
use_cases.description: Preview structural replacements before changing repeated code patterns across many files.

use_cases.title: Review Security-Sensitive Patterns
use_cases.description: Search for eval calls, unsafe HTML writes, command execution, and hardcoded secrets.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Function Call
prompt_templates.prompt: Use structural search to find every call to getUserById in this repository. Show files and explain the matching pattern.

prompt_templates.title: Search React Hooks
prompt_templates.prompt: Find React components that use useEffect with dependencies. Summarize the files and note any suspicious dependency patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Preview a Refactor
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ast-grep to preview replacing var declarations with const where the structure is safe. Do not apply changes until I approve.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Security Scan Rule
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ast-grep YAML rule that finds unsafe HTML assignment patterns. Include a clear message and test examples.

output_examples.input: Find every console logging call in the project.
output_examples.output: The assistant returns matching files, line summaries, and a suggested cleanup plan grouped by application area.

output_examples.input: Preview replacing legacy variable declarations with constants.
output_examples.output: The assistant reports candidate files, explains why each match is structurally valid, and asks before applying changes.

output_examples.input: Look for unsafe HTML assignment patterns in frontend code.
output_examples.output: The assistant lists possible XSS locations, separates likely false positives, and recommends manual review steps.

best_practices: Run preview searches before using rewrite commands that modify files.
Set the language explicitly when searching mixed-language repositories.
Review security matches manually before treating them as confirmed vulnerabilities.
anti_patterns: Do not use broad patterns when a named metavariable would narrow the result set.
Do not apply rewrite commands across the whole repository without reviewing the preview.
Do not treat every structural security match as exploitable without context.

faq.question: What does this skill use under the hood?
faq.answer: It guides the assistant to use the ast-grep CLI, also called sg, for AST-aware code search.

faq.question: Can it replace regular text search?
faq.answer: It complements text search. Use it when syntax structure matters more than exact text.

faq.question: Does it modify files automatically?
faq.answer: It can guide rewrite commands, but best practice is to preview changes and ask before applying them.

faq.question: Which languages are covered?
faq.answer: The included references cover JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, and general YAML rule usage.

faq.question: Can it find security issues?
faq.answer: It can search for risky code shapes, but a person must confirm whether each match is a real issue.

faq.question: Is ast-grep required?
faq.answer: Yes. The local ast-grep command must be installed before the assistant can run these searches.
